zh-CN.title: 《庄子》
zh-CN.subtitle: 庄周传统与复合篇章层
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《庄子》是道家寓言、哲学论辩与后世编纂传承的复合文本入口。
curatorialDescription: 人物庄周、篇章层和后世注疏分开建模，不把全书当作单一作者的逐字记录。
zh-CN.researchNote: 篇章归属、成书区间和注疏传承仍需逐篇核对。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约公元前 4–3 世纪；成书层次有争议

en.title: Zhuangzi
en.subtitle: The Zhuang Zhou tradition and layered chapters
en.shortSummary: The Zhuangzi is a composite entry into Daoist parable, philosophical debate and later textual transmission.
curatorialDescription: The figure Zhuang Zhou, chapter layers and later commentary remain separate rather than treating the whole text as a single verbatim authorial record.
en.researchNote: Chapter attribution, composition ranges and commentary transmission require item-level review.
en.timeLabel: c. fourth–third centuries BCE; layers contested

displayDate.zh-CN: 约公元前 4–3 世纪；成书层次有争议
displayDate.en: c. fourth–third centuries BCE; layers contested

zh-CN.title: 《孟子》
zh-CN.subtitle: 游说、政治伦理与经典化
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《孟子》保存孟轲及其学派关于性善、政治责任和教育的言说与编纂层。
curatorialDescription: 文本中的对话、传述和后世经典地位保持分层，避免把后世经学地位写回战国现场。
zh-CN.researchNote: 篇章形成、人物言说的记录层与汉唐以来经典化仍需继续拆分。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约公元前 4 世纪；传述与编纂层

en.title: Mengzi
en.subtitle: Itinerant counsel, political ethics and canonisation
en.shortSummary: The Mengzi preserves sayings and compiled layers associated with Meng Ke and his school on human nature, political responsibility and education.
curatorialDescription: Dialogue, transmission and later canonical status remain distinct rather than projecting later scholastic authority back into the Warring States setting.
en.researchNote: Chapter formation, recorded speech and later canonisation require further separation.
en.timeLabel: c. fourth century BCE; transmitted and compiled layers

displayDate.zh-CN: 约公元前 4 世纪；传述与编纂层
displayDate.en: c. fourth century BCE; transmitted and compiled layers

zh-CN.title: 《正一盟威道》传统
zh-CN.subtitle: 天师道组织与授受叙事的文本入口
zh-CN.shortSummary: 该入口用于追踪正一道/天师道的组织、授受与后世传记传统，不把不同成书层压成一卷书。
curatorialDescription: 人物祖师、经箓传统与后世神圣化分别进入关系和证据层。
zh-CN.researchNote: 具体经名、版本和成书年代需继续绑定道藏目录与传记资料。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 东汉至六朝形成层；年代不确

en.title: Zhengyi Mengwei Dao tradition
en.subtitle: A textual entry into Celestial Masters organisation and transmission
en.shortSummary: This entry traces Zhengyi/Celestial Masters organisation, transmission and hagiographic layers without collapsing different textual formations into one book.
curatorialDescription: Founder identity, registers and later sacralisation are kept in separate relation and evidence layers.
en.researchNote: Specific titles, editions and formation dates require Daoist-catalogue and biographical review.
en.timeLabel: Eastern Han to Six Dynasties formation layers; date uncertain

displayDate.zh-CN: 东汉至六朝形成层；年代不确
displayDate.en: Eastern Han to Six Dynasties formation layers; date uncertain

zh-CN.title: 《抱朴子》
zh-CN.subtitle: 葛洪的内外篇与道教知识论述
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《抱朴子》连接炼养、神仙论、政治伦理与东晋知识生产，是葛洪人物入口的核心文本。
curatorialDescription: 内篇、外篇、作者自述和后世道教接受保持不同证据层，不把术数叙述直接写成现代实验事实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 篇章版本、内外篇关系和后世注本仍需继续建立版本索引。

en.title: Baopuzi
en.subtitle: Ge Hong's inner and outer chapters and Daoist knowledge
en.shortSummary: The Baopuzi connects cultivation, immortality discourse, political ethics and Eastern Jin knowledge production as Ge Hong's core textual entry.
curatorialDescription: Inner and outer chapters, authorial self-presentation and later Daoist reception remain distinct; technical narratives are not rewritten as modern experimental fact.
en.researchNote: Chapter versions, inner/outer relationships and later commentaries require a fuller version index.

zh-CN.title: 阿育王敕诏
zh-CN.subtitle: 铭刻、治理与法的传播
zh-CN.shortSummary: 阿育王敕诏提供跨区域治理、伦理政策与铭刻传播的物证入口。
curatorialDescription: 敕诏文字、遗址分布与后世佛教传记分别建模；铭刻证据不自动证明所有传记叙事。
zh-CN.researchNote: 不同语种敕诏、年代与遗址序列需要逐条连接考古目录。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约公元前 268–232 年；铭刻与统治语境

en.title: Ashokan Edicts
en.subtitle: Inscriptions, governance and the circulation of dhamma
en.shortSummary: The Ashokan Edicts provide material evidence for transregional governance, ethical policy and inscriptional circulation.
curatorialDescription: Edict wording, site distribution and later Buddhist biography remain separate; inscriptional evidence does not automatically verify every biographical narrative.
en.researchNote: Edicts in different languages, dates and site sequences require item-level archaeological cataloguing.
en.timeLabel: c. 268–232 BCE; inscriptional and imperial context

displayDate.zh-CN: 约公元前 268–232 年；铭刻与统治语境
displayDate.en: c. 268–232 BCE; inscriptional and imperial context

zh-CN.title: 《中论》
zh-CN.subtitle: 中观论辩与龙树传统
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《中论》是龙树与中观哲学传统的核心论辩文本，影响后来的汉译佛教解释。
curatorialDescription: 文本归属、年代和汉译传播分开标注；后世宗派影响不直接写回龙树生平。
zh-CN.researchNote: 梵本、藏译、汉译与注疏链条需要进一步绑定版本和翻译记录。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约公元 2–3 世纪；年代与归属有争议

en.title: Mūlamadhyamakakārikā
en.subtitle: Madhyamaka argument and the Nāgārjuna tradition
en.shortSummary: The Mūlamadhyamakakārikā is a central argumentative text for Nāgārjuna and Madhyamaka traditions, with later influence on Chinese Buddhist interpretation.
curatorialDescription: Textual attribution, dating and Chinese transmission remain separate; later sectarian impact is not written back into Nāgārjuna's biography.
en.researchNote: Sanskrit, Tibetan, Chinese and commentary chains require edition- and translation-level links.
en.timeLabel: c. second–third centuries CE; date and attribution contested

displayDate.zh-CN: 约公元 2–3 世纪；年代与归属有争议
displayDate.en: c. second–third centuries CE; date and attribution contested

zh-CN.title: 《法华经》汉译传统
zh-CN.subtitle: 鸠摩罗什译经与经典流通
zh-CN.shortSummary: 此条以鸠摩罗什时期的汉译与流通层为入口，不把汉译节点等同于经文全部成书历史。
curatorialDescription: 经文的印度形成、汉译文本和后世接受分开建模；当前入口聚焦翻译与制度化传播。
zh-CN.researchNote: 具体译本、译者归属和版本谱系需继续接入佛典目录。

en.title: Lotus Sutra: Chinese translation tradition
en.subtitle: Kumarajiva's translation context and textual circulation
en.shortSummary: This entry focuses on the Chinese translation and circulation layer associated with Kumarajiva without equating it with the whole composition history of the scripture.
curatorialDescription: Indian formation, Chinese translation and later reception remain separate; the current entry foregrounds translation and institutional circulation.
en.researchNote: Specific translations, attribution and version genealogy require Buddhist-catalogue links.
en.timeLabel: c. 401–413; Chinese translation and circulation layer

displayDate.en: c. 401–413; Chinese translation and circulation layer

zh-CN.title: 《佛国记》／《法显传》
zh-CN.subtitle: 求法旅行与南亚见闻记录
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《佛国记》把法显的求法路线、僧团见闻和回国后的文字记录连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 旅行记录、后世路线图与具体遗址分别保留证据层，不把区域锚点画成逐日路线。
zh-CN.researchNote: 文本版本、译注与路线节点需继续按地点和段落拆分。

en.title: Foguoji / Record of Faxian
en.subtitle: Pilgrimage travel and observations across South Asia
en.shortSummary: The Foguoji connects Faxian's pilgrimage route, observations of monastic communities and the written record produced after his return.
curatorialDescription: Travel record, later route maps and specific sites retain separate evidence layers; regional anchors are not drawn as a day-by-day itinerary.
en.researchNote: Text versions, translations and route nodes require place- and passage-level separation.

zh-CN.title: 上古神话与道教宇宙叙事
zh-CN.subtitle: 开辟、造人、秩序与神圣谱系的文本见证
zh-CN.shortSummary: 该文本入口汇集盘古、女娲、伏羲、黄帝、西王母和太上老君相关的神话/神圣叙事层。
curatorialDescription: 这里展示的是文本记忆与宇宙叙事，不是可按历史地图验证的地理或人物生平。
zh-CN.researchNote: 不同文本、时代和地域的神话版本需要分别建档；当前只提供比较入口。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 神话与神圣传统时间：无单一历史纪年

en.title: Mythic and Daoist cosmological narratives
en.subtitle: Textual witnesses for creation, order and sacred genealogies
en.shortSummary: This text entry gathers mythic and sacred narrative layers associated with Pangu, Nuwa, Fu Xi, Huangdi, Xi Wangmu and Taishang Laojun.
curatorialDescription: It represents textual memory and cosmological narrative, not geography or biography that can be verified on a historical map.
en.researchNote: Versions across texts, periods and regions require separate records; this is currently a comparative gateway.
en.timeLabel: Mythic and sacred traditional time: no single historical date

displayDate.zh-CN: 神话与神圣传统时间：无单一历史纪年
displayDate.en: Mythic and sacred traditional time: no single historical date
